title: In properties dialog for item in the desktop:// IO worker, "Location" field inaccurately shows "/ (desktop)" instead of correct path
line: The Properties dialog of an item on the desktop now shows its real folder, like /home/user/Desktop, instead of "/ (desktop)".
explanation: KFilePropsPlugin built the Location field from the item's URL, so for desktop:/TestFolder it took the virtual path "/" and appended the scheme, giving "/ (desktop)". The desktop worker already maps its items to local files (UDS_LOCAL_PATH), but that was only used for the mount point and content type. Now the Location uses the folder of the item's local path when there is one (also when several items are selected), without the scheme suffix; trash:/ keeps its current display, since its local path is the internal Trash folder.

commits.message:
KPropertiesDialog: show the real location of items on desktop:/

Items in desktop:/ had their Location shown as "/ (desktop)", the path
of the virtual URL, even though the worker maps them to local files. Use
the local folder instead when the item has one, except for the trash.

BUG: 412670

media.caption: Properties of a folder on the desktop: Location shows "/ (desktop)"
Same folder with the fix: Location shows /home/kdetest9/Desktop
A folder and a file on the desktop selected together also show /home/kdetest9/Desktop

reviews.text: Resolving Location via KFileItem::isMostLocalUrl() in KIO's KFilePropsPlugin (while excluding trash:/) fixes desktop:/ items to show their real local directory for both single and multi-item selections without leaking the internal Trash path. Capturing showLocalDirectory before the multi-item loop avoids suppressing local path display when isLocal is cleared, and the screenshots and trash:/ regression check back it up.

The fix is in the right place (KFilePropsPlugin in KIO). It uses the item's mostLocalUrl, which the desktop worker already provides, so Location shows the real parent folder without the ' (desktop)' suffix. It excludes trash, which was the sticking point in the earlier kio!513. The per-item locationOf() keeps the multi-selection comparison consistent, and showLocalDirectory is computed before the loop that clears isLocal, so desktop:/ multi-selections still work, as after-2 shows. The change also sensibly improves other virtual workers that set UDS_LOCAL_PATH (e.g. recentlyused:/). The Windows branch drops the old mid(1) correctly because toLocalFile() already returns 'C:/…', but that path wasn't tested.
